definitions.explanation: The period of time after classes end for the day. Specifically refers to the time after school dismissal, typically used in the context of elementary through high school.

examples.japanese: {放課後|ほうかご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I hung out with friends after school.

examples.japanese: {放課後|ほうかご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have club practice after school.

examples.japanese: {放課後|ほうかご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}って→残る：01187_nokoru⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}した→質問する：05637_shitsumonsuru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed in the classroom after school and asked the teacher a question.

notes:
USAGE:
{放課後|ほうかご} specifically refers to the period after school classes end. It is primarily associated with elementary, middle, and high school contexts — not typically used for university. A culturally significant time in Japanese school life, as many students participate in ⟦{部活動|ぶかつどう}→部活動：14539_bukatsudou⟧ (club activities) during this period.

- {放課後|ほうかご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧: the classroom after school
- {放課後|ほうかご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to stay after school
- {放課後|ほうかご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: after-school activities
